Task: to add some polishing to json-formatter tool.
we need to add a new feature that allows us to resize the input and output text areas by dragging their borders. This will enhance the user experience by providing more flexibility in how they view and edit their JSON data. 
We also need to add syntax highlighting to the output text area. This will make it easier for users to read and understand their formatted JSON data. We can use a library like Prism.js or highlight.js to achieve this. we need to keep this feature configurable, so users can choose to enable or disable syntax highlighting based on their preferences. it should be on by default.
Finally, we should ensure that these new features are responsive and work well without impacting the overall performance of the tool. We can test the tool on various devices and screen sizes to ensure that it remains user-friendly and efficient though we optimize it specifically for desktop users, as they are the primary audience for this tool.
